description: Search the laws of the Republic of Korea (South Korea) in force by keyword (name, promulgation and effective dates). Use this first when you do not know the official law name. Korean abbreviations (근기법, 주임법) are expanded to the official name. An English query searches the official English titles and lists each law's Korean and English names. To ask in a sentence, use search_law_by_question.

query.description: Keyword in Korean or English. E.g. 근로기준법, 임대차, Labor Standards Act

name: search_law
title: Search Korean laws (법령 검색)
